tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, the cream paper every view sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised boxes that hold reading text: correction items, chat bubbles from AI, inputs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, headings and the thick outlines. Reads on bg, surface and every tint (11:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, explanations, dates. Only on bg and surface (5.3:1); not on tints.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Outlines of cards, chips, buttons, weekday tiles. Same as ink in light; softened in dark.

tokens.name: on-tone
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tone-* fill. Stays dark in both themes because the pastels stay light.

tokens.name: tone-green
tokens.usage: 今天 and 跟讀. Active nav pill on 今天, highlighter under corrected sentences.

tokens.name: tone-coral
tokens.usage: 口說. Offset outline behind the task card, hard shadow on primary buttons, brand title shadow.

tokens.name: tone-lilac
tokens.usage: 寫作. Shadow behind writing headings.

tokens.name: tone-yellow
tokens.usage: 卡片 and the one main action per view (存成卡片, 記得). Level badges, today's weekday.

tokens.name: tint-green
tokens.usage: Task card fill, 跟讀 weekday tile.

tokens.name: tint-coral
tokens.usage: 口說 weekday tiles, my own chat bubbles.

tokens.name: tint-lilac
tokens.usage: 寫作 weekday tiles, the C1 rewrite box.

tokens.name: tint-yellow
tokens.usage: 卡片/複習 weekday tile, flashcard answer side.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Small emphasised text: eyebrow labels (週三・今天), due counts, CEFR level in logs. On bg, surface, tint-green.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighter under the corrected natural sentence. Ink reads on it in both themes (light 9.5:1, dark 6.5:1).

tokens.name: strike
tokens.usage: Line-through on the learner's original wording (decoration, 3.4:1+ on bg/surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element.

families.body: "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Heiti TC", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: Site title only, with a 3px tone-coral offset shadow.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Big numbers: CEFR level in results, counts.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: 口說 10 分鐘：挑一個主題和 AI 聊

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: 這次對話的 5 個重點

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 用英文回覆。iPhone 上點鍵盤的麥克風就能用說的。

styles.name: small
styles.sample: agree 本身是動詞，前面不用 be 動詞。

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside badges; gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, buttons, weekday tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a list; small padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a view.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top padding of the header.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small boxes: weekday tiles, banner, inline highlights (✎ note, flashcard answer).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Everything that holds content: cards, correction items, inputs, chat bubbles, flashcard.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything you press or that labels: buttons, chips, nav tabs, level badges, count dots.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: The one outline weight for cards, chips, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: border-width-strong
tokens.usage: Offset outline behind the today task card only.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Selected nav tab, today weekday, accent buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-coral
tokens.usage: Primary (ink) buttons only.
